content:
anya: Quick brain-dump: we should add "per-route sampling guardrails" in Console so engineers can inspect sampled req/res without broad PII exposure.

sam: outline?

anya: small set of rules: 1) text-only routes allowed default debug sampling (very low); 2) file/attachment/embedding routes are auto-opt-out; 3) debug samples ephemeral (24h) and require breakglass; 4) audit samples ultra-rare + restricted.

devon: UX: show a compact badge near route config: "debug 0.01% / audit 0.001%" and a tooltip that explains what each sample contains. Also a redaction-confidence microchart.
lisa: redaction-confidence needs care. expose it as a banded signal (low/medium/high) not raw float to avoid false reassurance. include the reason tag (e.g., "email-detect", "ssn-like").
tom: infra: we need a global emergency kill-switch to set all debug rates to 0 instantly, and a per-tenant override precedence map. Also quota cap so debug sampling can't exceed org budget.

policy-bot: policy-scan: /v1/file-upload -> sensitivity 0.94 (auto-opt-out).

anya: yep auto-opt-out for upload and embedding routes. Also require explicit tenant opt-in flow and an audit entry for opt-ins.
sam: can we add a simple JSON snippet for config so product can wire the UI?

anya: example config: 
```
route: /v1/chat/complete
sampling:
  debug_rate: 0.0001    # 0.01%
  audit_rate: 0.00001   # 0.001%
redaction:
  strategy: mask-first
  display_confidence: banded
  attachments: auto_opt_out
```

devon: Console should estimate cost delta when toggling debug slider (preview) and show banner when global kill-switch active.
lisa: viewing any debug sample must require breakglass justification + store actor+reason. debug view TTL 24h. audit access follows stricter RBAC.
tom: add telemetry: histogram of redaction bands over time + weekly regression check tied to Optimize alerts for scrub failures.

anya: next steps: I'll draft a short RFC and prototype the badge + slider. owner: @devon for infra. sam can add compliance notes. I'll post RFC link here when ready.
sam: thanks, :thumbsup: make sure to list exact route patterns that auto-opt-out (uploads, embeddings, webhook-targets).
devon: will hook up kill-switch and quota caps.

anya: cool, will follow up with RFC.
